# Factions & Organizations

## American {#american}

The Americans possess whaling vessels and a continent bounded by a south-east coast that stretches to [Cape Horn](../codex/places.md#cape-horn).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P36](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P37](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P38](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), +18 more_

## French Government {#french-government}

The French Government attached an Assistant Professor from the Museum of Natural History in [Paris](../codex/places.md#paris) to a scientific expedition in Nebraska and, in 1791, manned two merchantmen to search for the missing circumnavigation corvettes sent out by Louis XVI.

_Sources: [v1 PART ONE P17](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0017), [v1 PART ONE P18](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0018), [v1 PART ONE P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 PART ONE P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), +14 more_

**Members:** [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md)

## Israelites {#israelites}

The Israelites were an ancient people led by Moses who famously crossed the [Red Sea](../codex/places.md#red-sea) to reach the Promised [Land](../character/ned-land.md), surviving an ordeal in which Pharaoh's pursuing army perished in the closing waters.

_Sources: [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P37](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0037), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 CHAPTER IV THE RED SEA P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), +19 more_

## Japanese {#japanese}

The Japanese possess a coastline along the Northern [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean and use the term Kuro-Scivo, or the Black River, to refer to a warm [North Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) ocean current.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P10](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P12](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0012), +18 more_

## Papuans {#papuans}

The Papuans are athletic, dark-skinned natives of [Papua](../codex/places.md#papua) and its neighboring islands who carry bows, arrows, shields, and slings, and whom Captain Nemo regards as poor wretches despite their potential threat to the grounded [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P22](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P23](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P24](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P25](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0025), +17 more_
